Pinned pure Go handles MIME, quotes, template merge, receipt formatting, signature placement, and calendar edits. Private artifacts replace filesystem inputs. Embedded attachment payloads stream through MIME skeletons and authenticated JSON; oversized files stream to Drive.

Hosted resource ceilings: authored body-file reads and retained draft text/header skeletons are capped at 8 MiB. Embedded attachment MIME streams up to the pinned 25 MiB EML limit. Pure transformation requests remain bounded by the free-tier engine limit; no shortcut flags or workflow branches are omitted.
